notes.title: Full Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43368998/af2e49d0d2d47f915b86e7cd7f9a4d95282ede3c.png

Dear Steam Community,

After a ton of hard work, we’re thrilled to announce the full release version of Locked In Mind!

Here’s what’s new:

The entire game has been remade in Unreal Engine 5!

 We’ve added a brand-new level with new puzzle mechanics
 Visuals have been drastically improved and we implemented AMD FSR3.1
 Sound and UI design have been significantly upgraded.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43368998/34e8b753c1de6dd00ad30fe928ede3f92b03dd65.png

And that’s not all! New levels are already in development!

We deeply appreciate your patience and support. As a small team, we’ve poured our hearts into creating this game, and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it.

https://i.ibb.co/98yqTj8/LIM2.gif

Very soon we will add the previous Unity version as a legacy launch option.

Thank you for being part of our journey!

Best regards,
The Locked In Mind Dev Team :)

notes.title: Unreal Engine 5 Playtest is out!
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community

We released the first level in Unreal Engine 5 as an open playtest!

Our team is super excited to hear your feedback as we continue to develop the game in UE5 while also working on new levels :)

https://i.ibb.co/7SXRkQQ/LIMUE5.png

We added new sounds, animations and custom made music.
This playtest also features AMD Fidelity FX for better performance, and many more graphics settings.

https://i.ibb.co/RQh2nKv/window.png

We hope you're just as excited as we are!
Feel free to use Steam's Community Hub feature for giving feedback and be sure to join our discord server as well.

Best Regards,
Locked In Mind Team

notes.title: We're Moving to Unreal Engine 5!
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community

We hope you've all been doing well! It's been a while since our last update, and we want to apologize for the radio silence. We know you've been waiting for news about our game, and today, we have some thrilling developments to share.

Transitioning to Unreal Engine: A Leap Forward

We're excited to announce that we've made the decision to move our game to the Unreal Engine. This shift represents a significant milestone in our game's development and opens up a world of possibilities for us. Unreal Engine's robust features, stunning graphics capabilities, and powerful tools will enable us to create an even more immersive and visually stunning experience for you, our players.

https://i.ibb.co/N9XfjND/Screenshot-2023-10-26-214108.png

This move has demanded our full attention and resources as we work to ensure a seamless transition to the new engine. While it has temporarily delayed the release of new levels, we believe that this change will ultimately result in a more engaging and visually stunning gaming experience. We appreciate your patience, and we promise that the wait will be worth it. 

Why Unreal Engine?

Unreal Engine has a long history of powering some of the most visually striking and critically acclaimed games. Its versatility and great lighting capabilities will help us achieve the level of quality and innovation we aspire to deliver in our project. We believe this transition will result in a game that exceeds your expectations in every way. 
For those who are interested we're rewriting our entire project in C++. 

https://i.ibb.co/PDpbQJD/Screenshot-2023-10-26-213950.png

What's Next?

With this significant engine transition underway, we're hard at work reimagining our game and making it better than ever. We can't wait to share more details, concept art, and development updates with you in the coming weeks and months.

Thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support. We wouldn't be where we are today without our fantastic community, and we're more determined than ever to deliver a game that will exceed your expectations.

Stay tuned for more updates, and please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or want to share your thoughts. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we look forward to embarking on this exciting new journey together.

Best Regards,
Locked In Mind Team

We wanted to take a moment to say a big 'thank you' to our amazing community! We couldn't have made it this far without your support, and we're truly grateful for every feedback and review.

As we continue to develop new levels for the game, we've decided to transition to a paid model in a few days. But don't worry - if you've already downloaded the game for free, you'll be able to keep it! We appreciate your loyalty and hope you'll continue to enjoy playing the game as much as we enjoy creating it for you.

We have made the decision to transition to a paid model in order to fund the development of new levels and to be able to hire more voice actors and artists. This will allow us to continue to innovate and improve the game, while ensuring that we can sustain its growth and provide the best experience possible for our players. We also plan on releasing a free demo with 2 levels shortly.

-Elevator
-Item pickup system
-Clue system
-Performance improvements
